title: Indian-Style Paella
description: A fusion of Indian spices with the classic Spanish dish, featuring tender meat and a flavorful rice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, rice, and yogurt. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot.
